thread:
eli_sales: Quick heads up — FinRegCo POC kickoff tomorrow. Their security team requires EU-only processing and an explicit sub-processor inventory. Can we confirm: do we have Dedicated capacity that can be pinned to EU regions only? Also need a clear answer on whether any logs/metrics leave EU. https://redwood.internal/sales/poc/finregco :eyes:

jana_eng: We have Dedicated pools in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. You can pin routing to a single region via a routing policy. Failover can be configured but that implies cross-region egress unless customer opts out.

jana_eng: Example routing snippet (config for the POC):
```yaml
routing_policy:
  mode: pin
  preferred_region: eu-west-1
  allow_failover: false
```

sarah_sec: @eli_sales good call. I need to run the POC ask through the Security Questionnaire (section 4: Subprocessors + Data Flows). I can confirm our subprocessor list for EU-hosted deployments (we use Vault/KMS in region, monitoring via regional aggregator). I'll link the matrix in a sec.

alex_ops: One ops caveat: if we force region pinning and disable failover, autoscaling across regions is off -> could impact burst capacity. Ballpark cost delta for guaranteed EU-only Dedicated = +~15% on monthly reserved capacity (depends on sizes).

eli_sales: Customer specifically asked: "Will telemetry or error traces ever be sent to US infra or our central monitoring?" They need that in writing for procurement.

sarah_sec: By default we ship anonymized metrics to a central backend for platform health, which lives in US. For Enterprise/Private we can disable remote export and keep logs in-region or ship to customer-managed S3 in EU. I will confirm exact fields that are redacted.

jana_eng: For the POC test plan I can provision a Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 and apply the above policy. I'll run a quick end-to-end after hours and post results (latency/cold-starts).

eli_sales: Also pricing question from buyer: is Dedicated POC discounted vs committed reserved? They want a 2-week POC at scale.

alex_ops: We normally do trial credits for 2-week POC; for Reserved/Dedicated we offer a short-term eval pricing (non-committal) — I'll draft two options: hourly vs temporary monthly pro-rate. Expect higher unit cost for short term.

poc-bot: POC checklist updated: subprocessor docs attached (EU providers: cloud-eu-1, logging-eu-ops), certs verified (ISO27001, SOC2), routing_policy sample committed to test cluster.

eli_sales: Next steps: @sarah_sec to confirm final subprocessor matrix + statement on telemetry retention; @jana_eng to push routing config to test cluster and validate no US egress; @alex_ops to add cost delta and short-term POC pricing to quote. I'll send customer a summary email after we confirm.

jana_eng: I'll post test results and `curl` example for pinned routing endpoint when done.

sarah_sec: I'll also add a short paragraph legal can sign that says "no logs will leave EU for this POC" once legal okays the wording.

eli_sales: Great — if we can close these three items today we can keep tomorrow's kickoff. :thumbsup: 

alex_ops: noted, I'll prepare a provisional cost line and include the impact if they later enable failover.

eli_sales: thanks all. I'll start drafting the email.

jana_eng: acked.

sarah_sec: ack.

poc-bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 18 hours for test results and legal signoff.
